_about.what: Five sample people for the Learner 360 prototype. All names, IDs, companies and numbers are invented.
_about.structure: header, stored_not_shown, learner_profile, academic_skill_profile, activity, insights, summary, interest_by_area
decisions_applied: Model v6: 24 activity types shown; consent changes stored for audit only; learning health dropped.
Sales Insights values carry source_label "Counselling call on {date}".
Owning business is stored but not shown on the UI (stored_not_shown).
Each value carries added_at only; no verified date.
Module x of y comes from Prism (userprograms.containerProgressInfo + programs.children[].totalLevel1Containers).
Internshala included; Unacademy out of scope.
Consent to share across upGrad is a new attribute with no source today.
_about.value_fields: attribute, value, display (masked, where shown), source_system, source_label (what the UI shows), source_field, added_at, confidence (declared / observed / derived), tier, conflict (optional)
_about.event_fields: occurred_at, event_type, sub_section, business, source_system, source_field, source_record_id, title, detail, payload, flag (optional)
